```artifact
Feature: User Experience and System Navigation

  Scenario: User should be able to navigate through the system easily
    Given the user is on the "Get Started" page
    When the user clicks on the "Help" button
    Then the user should be redirected to the "tutorial page"

  Scenario: System navigation should be simple and intuitive
    Given the user is on the "consultation request page"
    When the user clicks on the "Next" button
    Then the user should be taken to the next step in the consultation process

  Scenario: Consultation Request should be filled in less than 5 minutes
    Given the user is on the "consultation request page"
    When the user fills in the required fields and submits the request
    Then the request should be processed within 5 minutes

  Scenario: Installation Guide should be prepared
    Given the user is on the "installation steps" page
    When the user follows the installation steps
    Then the system should be successfully installed

  Scenario: User Manual for end users should be prepared
    Given the user is on the "help page"
    When the user reads the user manual
    Then the user should understand how to use the system
```
